fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`!pr Momir Vig, Simic Visionary` (and other vanguard/non-playable cards) returned no results because `update_index` filtered the card list to `playable_layouts` only, so vanguard, scheme, planar, emblem, etc. cards were never written to the Whoosh index at all.

## What changed

Following [Scryfall's approach suggested in the issue](https://github.com/PennyDreadfulMTG/Penny-Dreadful-Tools/issues/7766): search playable cards first, fall back to non-playable cards only when nothing matches.

**`magic/whoosh_write.py`**
- Added `playable=STORED()` field to the Whoosh schema.
- Changed the index filter from `is_playable_layout` to `uses_canonical_namespace` — this still excludes tokens, art series, and double-faced tokens (which share names with real cards and would cause conflicts), but now includes vanguard, scheme, planar, emblem, augment, and host cards.
- Each indexed document is now tagged with `playable=True/False`.

**`magic/whoosh_search.py`**
- `initialize_trie()` now builds two tries: `self.trie` (playable cards only, same behaviour as before) and `self.trie_all` (all indexed cards).
- `find_matches_by_prefix()` now accepts the trie to search as a parameter.
- `search()` tries the playable trie first; only if that yields no prefix match does it try the all-cards trie. Fuzzy/stemmed queries (the final fallback) now also search the full index, which covers typo-based lookups for non-playable cards.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed.
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit magic` — 849 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing), 89 deselected (functional/perf). Includes a new unit test `test_non_playable_card_found_via_fallback` that creates a vanguard card and a normal card in an in-memory index and asserts the vanguard is found by exact name and by prefix while the normal card is still found via the primary trie.

Fixes #7766

In magic/whoosh_search.py WhooshSearcher.initialize_trie(), build two tries — self.trie (playable-only) and self.trie_all (all cards) — from the playable flag.
